counts_contract.definition: for every item of every group, item.count must equal the total the board shows at the item's href (parseBoardQuery of the href, then listBoardFiltered); the response's total must equal what the board shows for the text as typed (landing as board.astro decides it); and item.disabled must be count === 0
counts_contract.memo: emptied before each case (every count comes from the store); a second pass leaves it to fill

strip_invariants.definition: on the board each case's text lands on, from listBoardFiltered's counts: remote kinds (remote + hybrid + onsite + unstated) sum to the total with no remote filter; country counts + the not-stated count sum to the total with no place filter; pay.any is the total with no pay filter. When the control IS set, the comparison is with the same board taken with that control let go.

suggest_cache_key.how: The endpoint's own GET handler is called in this process and the Cache-Control header it returns is read. A CDN honouring it is not part of this.
